Your Journey to Business Transformation Begins Here

Your Trusted Partner for Auto-ID, Data Capturing and Software Solutions

Rajeshwari Group, since 1991, is a provider of automatic identification, data capturing and software solutions. Our goal of providing customer centric solutions is served by strategic business units of our labelling and system integration. We have more than 30 years of industry experience in serving manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare, and other industries. We are an authorized partner of world’s leading OEMs for hardware technologies. We have an in-house software development as well as label manufacturing facility.

Your Trusted Partner

At Raj Barcode Solutions, we're more than just a barcode company; we're your partners in progress. We don't just sell products; we provide comprehensive solutions that elevate your business to new heights. Our dedicated solution team works side by side with you to handpick the perfect blend of printers, scanners, software, and consumables. We then weave them into a seamless system designed exclusively for you.

But we don't stop there. Our commitment extends beyond the sale. We take pride in our in-house label manufacturing, spares supply, hardware servicing and we also provide helpdesk support for any software queries. We're with you every step of the way, ensuring your operations run like clockwork.

Our Unique Promise

At Raj Barcode Solutions, we're not just in the business of providing solutions; we're in the business of transforming your business.

Single Point Management

We're your go-to for swift issue resolution and top-tier deliverables

Competitive Edge

Our team is not just qualified but certified by OEMs, ensuring you always get the best.

Experience:

With over 30 years in the industry, our expertise is your guarantee.

Flexibility

We tailor our engagement model to your unique needs, making sure you're always in control.

Reliability

Our dependable solutions have made us the preferred choice for IT automation projects across a wide array of sectors, including Manufacturing, Pharma, Healthcare, Chemicals, Logistics, and Government agencies.

OUR GROUP COMPANIES

As authorized partners of industry giants, we maintain a vast inventory of equipment, labels, ribbons, and replacement parts. This ensures competitive prices and almost immediate availability.

Rajeshwari Enterprise

Rajeshwari Enterprises established in the year 1990, deals with Handheld Labelling Systems. Rajeshwari Enterprises is a pioneer in Handheld Labelling Systems and associated with SATO for Handheld Labelling Equipment that helps organizations to mark thousands of items quickly and reliably. The product portfolio offered by the company is efficient, versatile, lightweight and easy to use.

Rajeshwari Label Manufacturing Company

Rajeshwari Label Manufacturing Company provides the complete solution for all types of consumables requirements with in-house capabilities to manufacture high performance barcode labels in various sizes and product labels up to six colors. Use of latest state of art machineries & skilled operators ensures that there is no compromise on technical specifications / requirements. This ensure higher productivity and total customer satisfaction.

The Power of Our Team

Our people are our greatest asset. Our team members are not just qualified; they're experts in their fields. From sales to software development and customer support, they're passionate about building strong partnerships with our cherished clients. They dive deep into your business needs, leveraging their years of experience and expertise to craft tailored solutions.
